templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence layered exemplar embedding a literal data-table object as one box and annotating command-line invocations on the flow arrows, split by one rule into a user-space band above and a kernel-space band below.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a tier's artifact as a literal table, columns and all, rather than a plain box when the paper's contribution is the schema itself, and write command strings right on the arrow that triggers them; keep matching colour bands consistent between the table and the running-kernel bar they describe.
